notes.n7.api: Crowded and capital-heavy: US leaders Fireworks ($17.5B, Jul 2026), Baseten ($13B, Jun 2026) and Together ($8.3B, Jul 2026) compete with chip-owning clouds (Groq, Cerebras, SambaNova) and neocloud token factories (Nebius); China has its own tier (SiliconFlow, PPIO) and India is nascent (Simplismart, E2E, Krutrim).
notes.n7.platform: Each hyperscaler runs a multi-model platform (Bedrock, Foundry, Vertex, OCI, watsonx); in China, ByteDance Volcano Engine, Alibaba Bailian, Baidu Qianfan and Tencent compete hard on token price.
notes.n7.engine: Consolidating on two open-source engines, vLLM and SGLang, each spun into a VC-backed company in Jan 2026 (Inferact $150M seed; RadixArk ~$100M seed); NVIDIA pushes TensorRT-LLM and Dynamo; HF TGI is in maintenance mode.
notes.n7.local: Built on llama.cpp/ggml (team joined Hugging Face Feb 2026) and Apple MLX; platform owners (Apple, Google, Qualcomm, Microsoft, Meta) control the NPU runtimes; 1-bit/compressed models (PrismML) are pushing larger models on-device.
notes.n7.opt: Optimisation is being absorbed by engines and chip vendors: NVIDIA bought OctoAI (2024), Deci (2024), Lepton and CentML (2025); Red Hat bought Neural Magic (Jan 2025). Independent value now sits in KV-cache reuse/offload (Tensormesh/LMCache $20M May 2026, WEKA, Pliops, Mooncake), speculative decoding (largely open-source: EAGLE, SpecForge, ArcticInference) and regional optimisation platforms (Simplismart, FriendliAI, Pruna, Doubleword).
notes.n7.compress: Thin, early segment: providers' own prompt/context caching (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, Bedrock) is the default; independent prompt/context-compression startups are seed-stage (The Token Company, Compresr - YC) plus Tileward, which pairs context compaction with compressed models; LLMLingua is the open-source reference.
notes.n7.route: Biggest 2026 consolidation: Palo Alto Networks closed Portkey (May 2026) and Stripe agreed to buy OpenRouter (Aug 2026, reported >$7B after a $1.3B Series B in May); gateways are being pulled into security (PANW, F5), API management (Kong, Solo.io) and payments (Stripe); open-source LiteLLM remains the default self-hosted proxy.
notes.n7.obs: LLM observability is being absorbed by data/infra platforms: Langfuse to ClickHouse (Jan 2026), Helicone to Mintlify (Mar 2026), OpenMeter to Kong (Sep 2025), W&B to CoreWeave (2025); cost attribution (CloudZero, Vantage, Pay-i, Revenium) overlaps with n4.finops.
notes.n7.private: Hyperscalers and Apple/Google now offer enclave-based private AI; startups (Opaque, Edgeless, Tinfoil) sell attested confidential inference; on-prem demand served by Cohere, Mistral and server OEMs.
notes.n7.bench: Fragmented: independent analysts (Artificial Analysis, SemiAnalysis), non-profits (MLCommons, Epoch), crowd arenas (LMArena) and Chinese leaderboards (OpenCompass, SuperCLUE).

entries.name: Portkey AI Gateway (OSS)
entries.access: npx @portkey-ai/gateway or Docker; route across providers
entries.one_liner: Lightweight open gateway: unified API, retries, fallbacks, load-balancing and guardrail hooks.

entries.name: Ray Serve
entries.access: pip install 'ray[serve]'; Ray Serve LLM wraps vLLM
entries.one_liner: Python-native scalable serving library on Ray, with LLM APIs for multi-node vLLM deployments.
entries.note: Ray joined the PyTorch Foundation in Oct 2025.

entries.name: RouteLLM
entries.access: pip install routellm; OpenAI-compatible server routing strong/weak models
entries.one_liner: Framework and trained routers for cost-aware routing between strong and weak LLMs.

entries.name: SGLang (open)
entries.access: pip install sglang; launch an OpenAI-compatible server on GPUs
entries.one_liner: Fast serving framework with RadixAttention prefix caching, structured output and prefill/decode disaggregation.

entries.name: TensorRT-LLM
entries.access: pip/NGC container; compile and serve models on NVIDIA GPUs
entries.one_liner: NVIDIA's optimised LLM inference library: kernels, quantisation, speculative decoding, in-flight batching.

entries.name: TensorZero (open)
entries.access: Docker gateway; GitHub repo now read-only
entries.one_liner: Rust LLM gateway with observability, evals, experimentation and optimisation feedback loop.
entries.note: GitHub repo archived (read-only) by owner on 12 Jun 2026; reason not verified.

entries.name: Text Generation Inference (TGI)
entries.access: Docker image; legacy deployments only
entries.one_liner: Hugging Face's Rust/Python LLM serving server, now in maintenance mode.
entries.note: Put in maintenance mode, then archived read-only on 21 Mar 2026; HF points users to vLLM/SGLang.

entries.name: Triton Inference Server
entries.access: NGC container; serve TensorRT, PyTorch, ONNX and Python models
entries.one_liner: Multi-framework model server with dynamic batching, ensembles and metrics; widely used for non-LLM inference.
entries.note: NVIDIA positions Dynamo for LLM serving; Triton continues as general model server.

entries.name: vLLM (open)
entries.access: pip install vllm; self-host on NVIDIA, AMD, TPU and other accelerators
entries.one_liner: High-throughput LLM serving engine with PagedAttention, continuous batching and an OpenAI-compatible server.

entries.name: vLLM Semantic Router
entries.access: Deploy with Envoy ext_proc in front of model endpoints
entries.one_liner: Intent-aware router picking models per request, with semantic caching and jailbreak/PII filters.
